description: This PHP source file contains utility functions for input validation, including checks for printable characters, IP addresses, URLs, MAC addresses, ports, IDs, time ranges, days, SSID names, and string characters. It also initializes a CSRF protection library and sets locale settings for web UI.

methods.name: printableCharacters
methods.description: Checks if input contains only printable ASCII characters within a specified range or all printable characters if range is not specified.

methods.name: noSpace
methods.description: Checks if input contains any non-whitespace characters.

methods.name: validIPAddr
methods.description: Validates if the input is a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address.

methods.name: validLink
methods.description: Validates if the input is a valid URL based on a regex pattern.

methods.name: validMAC
methods.description: Validates if the input is a valid MAC address, excluding broadcast address and addresses with an odd first byte.

methods.name: validPort
methods.description: Checks if port number is between 1 and 65535.

methods.name: validId
methods.description: Checks if ID is in the range 1-256.

methods.name: validId_PC
methods.description: Validates parental control IDs, allowing ranges like '10_12' or single IDs.

methods.name: isValInArray
methods.description: Checks if a value exists within an array.

methods.name: isValInRange
methods.description: Checks if a value falls within a specified min and max range.

methods.name: validURL
methods.description: Validates URLs with complex regex patterns for both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.

methods.name: validTime
methods.description: Checks if start time is less than end time and both are within 00:00-23:59.

methods.name: validDays
methods.description: Validates if input days are among Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun.

methods.name: valid_ssid_name
methods.description: Validates SSID name for length, reserved prefixes, and forbidden substrings.

methods.name: is_allowed_string
methods.description: Checks if string does not contain invalid characters like <, >, &, ', ", |.

methods.name: remove_special_char
methods.description: Checks if string does not contain special characters like !, @, #, $, %, ^, &, *, (, ), ?, ", :, {, }, |, <, >.
